# mixed-axis

One sheet holding two things of different kinds: a file that lands on the host
(`keycloak.conf`) and a realm definition that does not — it is imported through
the product's own API, so there is no deployed path for it at all.

This is the shape that only became visible once a category derived from a file
started saying so: measured across one real project, three sheets mix a
file-marked category with unmarked ones, and NONE of the repository's own
examples do. Design decided against the examples alone would be deciding about
a situation that does not arise in them.

Built by the CLI in whatever reads it, never hand-written into a model.
